title: Cathedral Basilica of Zacatecas
geometryBasis: Original mapped way 746186615 fixes the main cathedral perimeter and Avenida Hidalgo façade. INAH monument I-32-00596 records the three-aisle Latin-cross plan and separates the adjoining parish house.
sectionBasis: INAH reports about 45 meters. The cleared originals document the two open stages of both bell towers, rose-colored stone, side portal and cream crossing dome with ribs. The UNAM field study describes the three sculpted west-front tiers, round choir window and octagonal drum. Exact section dimensions, carvings and original grades are estimates.
limitations: The main footprint, 45-meter height, two-stage belfries, three-part west front and octagonal crossing drum are documented. The nave section, roof forms, individual tower dimensions and stone ornament are proportional estimates.
The Qualla photograph has conflicting 2007 EXIF and 2009 description dates. The model uses the late-2000s exterior corroborated by independent 2008 photographs.

The 128-meter elevation field is unchanged. The west threshold and side steps follow approximate original provider grade. Interiors, individual statuary identities and the separately mapped parish house are outside scope.
